# Arekas

> Arekas is a nature destination in Rajanukunte, North Bangalore (near Yelahanka), Karnataka, India. It has two brands on one farm property: **Arekas Arena**, a 2.5 acre outdoor event venue for weddings, engagements, birthdays, corporate events and private gatherings (up to 500 guests), and **Arekas Bamboo Arcadia**, a farm stay with handcrafted bamboo cottages, a swimming pool and open-air dining. Both are operated by KR Endeavours.

## Key facts

- Venue address: Arekere Village, Rajanukunte, 2nd Hobli, Yelahanka Taluk, Bengaluru, Karnataka 562163, India
- Coordinates: 13.1149, 77.5499 (north of Yelahanka, reached via Bellary Road / NH44)
- Nearby areas: Yelahanka, Doddaballapur, Jakkur, Hebbal, Devanahalli, Thanisandra, Vidyaranyapura
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 89511 26633
- Email (events): arekas.arena@gmail.com
- Email (farm stay): bambooblissfarmstay@gmail.com
- Property: 2.5 acres of arecanut palms, bamboo groves, open lawn, koi pond
- Event capacity: up to 500 guests
- Dining: 3,000 sq ft bamboo dining pavilion; 100+ seated, 250–300 buffet/cocktail
- Stage: 500 sq ft; dedicated bride & groom rooms near the stage
- Accommodation: 4 bamboo cottages + 2 dormitories (about 28–30 guests)
- Facilities: swimming pool, on-site temple, bonfire area, pergola, koi pond, on-site parking
- Legal entity: KR Endeavours, GSTIN 29ABFFK2060G1ZF, No. 42, 7th Cross, Patel Pille, Ramchandrapura, Vidyaranyapura, Bengaluru 560097

## Pricing (INR)

- Arekas Arena 12-hour package: ₹1,80,000 for up to 500 guests (accommodation charged separately)
- Arekas Arena 24-hour package: ₹3,50,000 for up to 500 guests (accommodation complimentary)
- Both packages include full venue hire (lawn, stage, dining pavilion), Nadaswaram team, Dhol team, event planners and an event host. 50% advance to book.
- Add-ons: buffet catering from ~₹490 per plate; decoration from ₹42,000 (up to ₹1,00,000 for 24-hour events); photography ₹25,000–₹35,000 (up to ₹1,00,000 for 24-hour events)
- Bamboo Arcadia cottage: ₹5,999 per night for 2 adults
- Bamboo Arcadia dormitory: ₹25,000 per night for up to 10 adults
